⌈

Activate
method
is called),
UCM
shall perform a dependency check to ensure that all the
Software

having dependencies toward each other have been processed successfully,

ApplicationError MissingDependencies

7.1.6.2 Rollback
[SWS_UCM_00005] Rollback to the software prior to Finish the update process
⌈
UCM
shall provide a method
Rollback
to recover from an activation that went wrong.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00008)
Rollback can be called in the case of A/B partitions or
UCM

maintain backups of updated or removed
Software Packages
.
[SWS_UCM_00110] Rolling-back the software update
⌈
At
kRollingBack
state,
UCM
shall disable the changes done by the software update by calling
State Manage-
ment UpdateRequest
Service Interface
PrepareRollback
method for each
Func-
tion Group
of the processed
Software Cluster
in the update session. Then
UCM
shall call
State Management UpdateRequest
Service Interface
ResetMa-
chine
method if any
Software Cluster
requires a machine reboot to be rolled
back.
